tasks.title: 交付 Agent Session Composer
tasks.objective: 把 Composer 从 Activity 条件分支提升为 Agent Session Region 的稳定输入面，并拆成可复用受控组件与 Session adapter。
tasks.outcome: Agent 在 Terminal 与 Activity 中都拥有同一个可扩展 Composer，切换投影不丢草稿；Raw Terminal 无 Composer，表面没有黑色填充或投影。
acceptance: Agent Terminal 与 Agent Activity 都显示同一个 Composer；投影切换不卸载组件或清空未发送草稿。
launching、disconnected、exited 与 interrupted Agent 仍显示 Composer，但不可交互；Renderer 不猜测 Core Prompt readiness。
Raw Terminal 永远不显示 Agent Composer。
AgentComposer 是受控且无 Store 依赖的可复用组件；AgentSessionComposer 唯一绑定草稿、当前文件、Submit 与 Interrupt。
Composer 表面透明，只保留边界与 focus ring，不使用黑色填充或黑色 drop shadow。
正式产品规则只由 docs/design/orca-interaction-review.md 持有，旧计划不复制第二份。
定向 Renderer 测试、Desktop typecheck、完整 fast suite 与 git diff check 通过。

verification.proves: Agent Composer 行为没有破坏 Core 与 Desktop 快速回归。
受控组件、Session adapter 与 SessionPane 边界保持类型正确。
Composer 的对象归属、状态、Raw Terminal 非目标和视觉合同保持唯一记录。

documentation.rationale: The owning Desktop interaction SSOT now defines Composer ownership, lifecycle visibility, reusable component boundary, Prompt readiness boundary, Raw Terminal non-goal, and transparent surface.

learning.rationale: The change repaired one local ownership condition and component coupling without revealing a reusable repository-level principle beyond the existing design and coding rules.

promotion.rationale: No cross-repository runtime or skill capability changed; the result belongs in the AgentMux Desktop design SSOT and code.
